name: fn_add_integers
description: Add two integers together and return their sum.

name: fn_add_floats
description: Add two floating point numbers together and return their sum.

name: fn_multiply_integers
description: Multiply two integers together and return their product.

name: fn_multiply_floats
description: Multiply two floating point numbers together and return their product.

name: fn_divide_integers
description: Divide one integer by another integer and return the result as an integer.

name: fn_divide_floats
description: Divide one floating point number by another floating point number and return the result.

name: fn_get_square_root
description: Calculate the square root of a number.

name: fn_is_even
description: Check whether an integer is even. Return true if it is even and false otherwise.

name: fn_is_positive
description: Check whether a number is greater than zero. Return true if it is positive and false otherwise.

name: fn_is_greater_than
description: Check whether the first number is greater than the second number.

name: fn_is_adult
description: Check whether a person's age is at least 18.

name: fn_set_volume
description: Set the volume to a floating point value.

name: fn_set_lives
description: Set the number of lives to an integer value.

name: fn_configure_player
description: Configure a player using an integer number of lives, a floating point movement speed, and a boolean invincibility setting.
